description: The fifty hooks HookForge set out to build. Entries whose contract has shipped are described authoritatively by their generated manifest in hooks/; this file is the plan, and the source of the roadmap.

hooks.name: ArbTaxDecay
hooks.summary: Prices staleness: the longer a pool sits untraded, the more the next swap pays. Recaptures loss-versus-rebalancing with no oracle.

hooks.name: PriorityFeeTax
hooks.summary: Charges in proportion to the priority fee a swap paid for its place in the block, on the theory that only racing flow bids.

hooks.name: BlockBatchClearing
hooks.summary: Queues every swap in a block and clears them at one uniform price, so position inside the block stops being worth anything.

hooks.name: TopOfBlockAuction
hooks.summary: An on-chain auction for the right to trade first in a block, with the winning bid paid to liquidity providers.

hooks.name: FlowClassifier
hooks.summary: Publishes a running toxic-versus-benign classification of a pool's order flow on-chain, as a public good other hooks can read.

hooks.name: ImpactSplit
hooks.summary: Splits a large swap into tranches across blocks and guarantees the result beats immediate execution.

hooks.name: SandwichBond
hooks.summary: Lets a swapper post a bond returned unless a same-block backrun is detected, in which case it compensates them.

hooks.name: YieldSpace
hooks.summary: A fixed-rate curve with a maturity, converging to par at expiry. Interest-rate markets as a native v4 pool.

hooks.name: LMSR
hooks.summary: A logarithmic market scoring rule curve, giving prediction markets bounded loss and always-available liquidity.

hooks.name: PowerPerp
hooks.summary: An x^p invariant, so a liquidity position has power-perpetual payoff instead of the usual square-root exposure.

hooks.name: RatchetFloor
hooks.summary: A protocol-owned bid that can only move up, giving a token a floor price enforced by the curve itself.

hooks.name: GridLadder
hooks.summary: Asymmetric bid and ask ladders in one position, so a provider can quote a spread rather than a symmetric range.

hooks.name: DutchClearingLaunch
hooks.summary: A descending-price launch that ends in a single clearing price, refunding everyone who bid above it.

hooks.name: StepCurve
hooks.summary: Piecewise-constant prices, for assets that should trade in discrete steps rather than on a continuum.

hooks.name: RebaseAbsorb
hooks.summary: Makes rebasing tokens safe in v4 by absorbing balance drift into the pool as a donation to liquidity providers.

hooks.name: FeeOnTransfer
hooks.summary: Makes fee-on-transfer tokens work by settling on measured balance deltas instead of requested amounts.

hooks.name: YieldDiscount
hooks.summary: Parks idle reserves in an ERC-4626 vault and pays the yield out as fee discounts to swappers.

hooks.name: DividendPassthrough
hooks.summary: Routes dividends paid to pool-held tokens through to liquidity providers pro rata.

hooks.name: NativeYield
hooks.summary: On chains with native yield, donates the pool's accrued yield to in-range liquidity.

hooks.name: CircuitBreaker
hooks.summary: Halts swapping for a cooldown after a limit move, then clears itself. No admin key, and liquidity can always leave.

hooks.name: OracleBand
hooks.summary: Requires a swap to clear within a band around a signed reference price, so a thin pool cannot be walked away from reality.

hooks.name: DepegShield
hooks.summary: Fees rise superlinearly with distance from a peg and fall for swaps that restore it.

hooks.name: ILInsurance
hooks.summary: Skims a slice of fees into a vault that pays impermanent-loss claims to the providers who funded it.

hooks.name: DrawdownCap
hooks.summary: Caps how much price impact one address may cause per epoch.

hooks.name: LiquidityFloor
hooks.summary: Enforces a minimum liquidity that cannot leave while a pool is young.

hooks.name: TickHarberger
hooks.summary: Auctions the exclusive right to provide liquidity at the active tick under a Harberger tax, so it is always for sale.

hooks.name: TenureWeightedFees
hooks.summary: Weights fee share by continuous time in the pool, so capital that stays is paid more than capital that visits.

hooks.name: RangeRent
hooks.summary: Charges and pays rent for range occupancy based on how much of the range was actually used.

hooks.name: AutoCompoundDonate
hooks.summary: Donates accrued fees straight back to in-range liquidity, compounding without touching positions.

hooks.name: RetroRebate
hooks.summary: Pays volume rebates from on-chain epoch accounting, with no Merkle drop and no off-chain claim.

hooks.name: FungibleRange
hooks.summary: Tokenises a range position as an ERC-20 so it can be traded, lent and used as collateral.

hooks.name: X402Gate
hooks.summary: Meters pool access with x402 payment receipts, so an autonomous agent can pay per swap for a better fee tier.

hooks.name: AgentReputationFee
hooks.summary: Sets the fee tier from the swapper's on-chain agent reputation.

hooks.name: AgentBudget
hooks.summary: Enforces per-agent rate limits and spend budgets in the pool itself, not in the agent's own code.

hooks.name: IntentSettle
hooks.summary: Settles signed ERC-7683 intents against pool liquidity, with solvers competing on the fill.

hooks.name: HookMeter
hooks.summary: Instruments another hook: gas, revert rate and fee take, published on-chain for anyone to audit.

hooks.name: HookStack
hooks.summary: Runs an ordered stack of sub-hooks on one pool, each with its own gas budget.

hooks.name: ExpirySettle
hooks.summary: Gives a pool a maturity date at which it settles, turning it into a dated instrument.

hooks.name: VestedBuy
hooks.summary: Vests purchases linearly and enforces the schedule at the pool rather than in a token contract.

hooks.name: EpochRebalance
hooks.summary: Rebalances the pool toward a target weight each epoch, making the pool itself an index.

hooks.name: StreamDCA
hooks.summary: Executes recurring dollar-cost-average streams block by block.

hooks.name: TradingCalendar
hooks.summary: Opens and closes the pool on a schedule, ramping fees at the edges instead of slamming shut.

hooks.name: SharedLiquidity
hooks.summary: Mirrors one pool across chains and settles the net position, so liquidity is not fragmented per chain.

hooks.name: L1Anchor
hooks.summary: Anchors an L2 pool to a proven L1 price.

hooks.name: VarianceSwap
hooks.summary: Pays realized variance, making liquidity providers short volatility and traders long it, explicitly.

hooks.name: ImpliedVolFee
hooks.summary: Prices swaps off an implied-volatility surface rather than a realized-volatility estimate.

hooks.name: AntiSnipeRamp
hooks.summary: Opens at a punitive fee that decays to normal, paying the whole premium to liquidity rather than to the deployer.

hooks.name: CommitRevealDark
hooks.summary: Hides order size behind a hash commitment and clears the batch on reveal.

hooks.name: LotteryFees
hooks.summary: Sends a slice of fees to a no-loss lottery among the pool's liquidity providers.

hooks.name: ReserveStable
hooks.summary: Mints and burns against a reserve to hold a band, with the band enforced by the hook.
